colossus.origin: A foundry sentinel remains bound to the Crystal Crucible. Runeforged refers to the inscriptions cut into its frame, not spell currency: Veldren mages consume Relics.
colossus.tactics: The Colossus stays anchored. Leave the cleave circle and marked impact spots. Below half health, Crimson Overload shortens its attack intervals.

varkesh.origin: Varkesh nests above the abandoned Ashwatch galleries. The scorched watch camp and exposed ascent mark the route into its roost.
varkesh.tactics: Its breath follows a committed facing. Step sideways out of the green cone; range alone will not keep you safe.

veyr.origin: The Wardkeepers held Veyr beneath Ironhollow. The forged orders, sabotaged mine and altered shrine memories lead to that prison.
veyr.tactics: Follow the solid ground warnings, not the voices. Complete the counter-ward preparations with Alaric for assistance in the story encounter.

xalith.origin: The root caverns below Moonwillow shelter Xalith and her amber nursery. The nesting chambers are an inhabited lair, not a sealed treasure room.
xalith.tactics: The Broodmother closes for melee attacks. Watch the scythe strike, keep room to retreat, and bring food suited to a long fight.
